name: @w6w-apps/jibble
description: Track time, manage people and run attendance reports against the Jibble time-tracking API.

w6w.longDescription:
Jibble is a time-tracking and attendance platform built around clocking in and out, either from the mobile/web apps or a shared kiosk. This app covers the workflow-relevant slice of its OData-flavoured REST API: reading and maintaining the organization's people, locations, activities, projects, clients and groups; clocking a person in or out, listing and correcting raw time entries, and reading someone's latest clock state; time-off requests end to end (list, create, approve/reject/cancel) plus leave balances; and the attendance side — daily timesheets and the cross-team tracked-time report.

Every list action exposes Jibble's own OData query parameters ($select, $filter, $expand, $orderby, $top, $skip, $count) directly, because that is the only way to ask this API for less than everything — there is no separate simplified query surface.

Authentication is a single OAuth2 client-credentials grant scoped to the whole organization (Jibble issues one API-wide scope, `api1` — there is no per-endpoint scoping to navigate). Kiosks, schedules, screenshots, payroll pay-periods, calendars/holidays and webhooks are part of the vendor's API but are not covered here; see the README for exactly what's in and out.
